title: Spain Galicia Crop fields
description: Official field boundaries for the Galicia region of Spain, sourced from the SIXPAC Geographic Information System for Agricultural Plots. Contains 4,963,127 parcels with crop classification and administrative codes, converted to fiboa GeoParquet format. SIXPAC is the mandatory EU Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) reference database for identifying agricultural plots eligible for direct aid subsidies.

## README.md
# Field boundaries for Spain Galicia

Provides 4963127 official field boundaries from Spain Galicia
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from data obtained from Xunta de Galicia - Oficina Virtual del Medio Rural.

- **Source Data Provider:** [Xunta de Galicia - Oficina Virtual del Medio Rural](https://ovmediorural.xunta.gal/es/consultas-publicas/sixpac)
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **License:** CC-BY-4.0 (See https://mapas.xunta.gal/gl/aviso-legal , https://medioambiente.xunta.gal/seccion-organizacion/c/CMAOT_Instituto_Estudos_Territorio?content=Direccion_Xeral_Sostibilidade_Paisaxe/Informacion_publica/seccion.html&std=pgcix_2022_2025.html)
- **Projection:** EPSG:25829

---

- [Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-ga/es_ga.parquet)
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/es-ga/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-ga/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-ga/es_ga.pmtiles)
